verdict.rationale: Glama's own Gateway documentation says every MCP call through the Gateway URL is logged, so you know exactly what your agents are doing. That is the core of the story, but the docs never describe what a log entry contains, nor any audit view, export, or replay feature. The Inspector's JSON-RPC protocol log is a testing tool for arbitrary servers, not a platform-wide audit trail, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented log fields (arguments, results, caller, timestamps), an audit/search UI or export, replay capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see a log of every tool call that passed through the platform, with enough detail to audit or replay what an agent did

citations.quote: Every call through this URL is logged, access-controlled, and credential-managed
Every MCP call from your agents flows through Glama – so you know exactly what your AI is doing
Deploy any server from the registry to Glama and we automatically put the Gateway in front of it.
